mapper.select: select u.nick_name from sys_user u join sys_user_profile p on p.user_id = u.user_id join sys_dept target_dept on target_dept.dept_id = #{shopId} where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and p.employee_status in ('试用', '正式', '在职', '待离职') and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.dept_type = 'STORE' and ( exists ( select 1 from sys_dept employee_dept where employee_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id and employee_dept.status = '0' and employee_dept.del_flag = '0' and (employee_dept.dept_id = target_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(target_dept.dept_id, employee_dept.ancestors)) ) or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_shop us where us.user_id = u.user_id and us.dept_id = target_dept.dept_id ) ) limit 1

select schedule_id scheduleId, user_id userId, user_name userName, shop_id shopId, business_date businessDate, status, shift_name_snapshot shiftNameSnapshot, punch_mode_snapshot punchModeSnapshot, start_time_snapshot startTimeSnapshot, end_time_snapshot endTimeSnapshot, cross_day_snapshot crossDaySnapshot, check_in_open_minutes_snapshot checkInOpenMinutesSnapshot, check_in_close_minutes_snapshot checkInCloseMinutesSnapshot, check_out_open_minutes_snapshot checkOutOpenMinutesSnapshot, check_out_close_minutes_snapshot checkOutCloseMinutesSnapshot from oa_attendance_schedule where schedule_id = #{scheduleId}

select schedule_id scheduleId, user_id userId, user_name userName, shop_id shopId, business_date businessDate, status, shift_name_snapshot shiftNameSnapshot, punch_mode_snapshot punchModeSnapshot, start_time_snapshot startTimeSnapshot, end_time_snapshot endTimeSnapshot, cross_day_snapshot crossDaySnapshot, check_in_open_minutes_snapshot checkInOpenMinutesSnapshot, check_in_close_minutes_snapshot checkInCloseMinutesSnapshot, check_out_open_minutes_snapshot checkOutOpenMinutesSnapshot, check_out_close_minutes_snapshot checkOutCloseMinutesSnapshot from oa_attendance_schedule where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} for update

select schedule_id scheduleId, user_id userId, user_name userName, shop_id shopId, business_date businessDate, status, shift_name_snapshot shiftNameSnapshot, punch_mode_snapshot punchModeSnapshot, start_time_snapshot startTimeSnapshot, end_time_snapshot endTimeSnapshot, cross_day_snapshot crossDaySnapshot, check_in_open_minutes_snapshot checkInOpenMinutesSnapshot, check_in_close_minutes_snapshot checkInCloseMinutesSnapshot, check_out_open_minutes_snapshot checkOutOpenMinutesSnapshot, check_out_close_minutes_snapshot checkOutCloseMinutesSnapshot from oa_attendance_schedule where user_id = #{userId} and shop_id = #{shopId} and business_date between #{dateFrom} and #{dateTo} and status in ('PUBLISHED', 'CHANGED') order by business_date desc, schedule_id desc

select schedule_segment_snapshot_id scheduleSegmentSnapshotId, schedule_id scheduleId, segment_order segmentOrder, segment_type segmentType, start_minute_offset startMinuteOffset, end_minute_offset endMinuteOffset from oa_attendance_schedule_segment_snapshot where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and schedule_segment_snapshot_id = #{scheduleSegmentSnapshotId}

select schedule_segment_snapshot_id scheduleSegmentSnapshotId, schedule_id scheduleId, segment_order segmentOrder, segment_type segmentType, start_minute_offset startMinuteOffset, end_minute_offset endMinuteOffset from oa_attendance_schedule_segment_snapshot where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} order by segment_order, schedule_segment_snapshot_id

select e.punch_event_id punchEventId, e.schedule_id scheduleId, e.user_id userId, e.shop_id shopId, e.business_date businessDate, e.punch_type punchType, e.schedule_segment_snapshot_id scheduleSegmentSnapshotId, e.punch_slot_key punchSlotKey, ss.segment_order segmentOrder, e.server_punch_time serverPunchTime, e.verification_status verificationStatus from oa_attendance_punch_event e left join oa_attendance_schedule_segment_snapshot ss on ss.schedule_segment_snapshot_id = e.schedule_segment_snapshot_id and ss.schedule_id = e.schedule_id where e.punch_event_id = #{punchEventId}

select e.punch_event_id punchEventId, e.schedule_id scheduleId, e.user_id userId, e.shop_id shopId, e.business_date businessDate, e.punch_type punchType, e.schedule_segment_snapshot_id scheduleSegmentSnapshotId, e.punch_slot_key punchSlotKey, ss.segment_order segmentOrder, e.server_punch_time serverPunchTime, e.verification_status verificationStatus from oa_attendance_punch_event e left join oa_attendance_schedule_segment_snapshot ss on ss.schedule_segment_snapshot_id = e.schedule_segment_snapshot_id and ss.schedule_id = e.schedule_id where e.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and e.user_id = #{userId} and e.verification_status = 'ACCEPTED' order by e.server_punch_time, e.punch_event_id

select ls.leave_segment_id leaveSegmentId, ls.leave_request_id leaveRequestId, ls.start_time startTime, ls.end_time endTime, ls.total_minutes totalMinutes, ls.paid_minutes paidMinutes, ls.unpaid_minutes unpaidMinutes from oa_attendance_leave_segment ls join oa_attendance_leave_request lr on lr.leave_request_id = ls.leave_request_id join oa_attendance_schedule sch on sch.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and sch.user_id = lr.user_id and sch.shop_id = lr.shop_id where sch.status in ('PUBLISHED', 'CHANGED') and ls.segment_status = 'ACTIVE' and lr.user_id = #{userId} and lr.shop_id = #{shopId} and lr.status = 'APPROVED' and ls.start_time < timestamp( case when sch.cross_day_snapshot = 1 then date_add(sch.business_date, interval 1 day) else sch.business_date end, sch.end_time_snapshot) and ls.end_time > timestamp( sch.business_date, sch.start_time_snapshot) order by ls.start_time, ls.leave_segment_id
mapper.sql: select r.correction_request_id, r.correction_request_no, r.client_request_id, r.client_request_fingerprint, r.user_id, r.user_name, r.shop_id, r.schedule_id, r.business_date, r.correction_type, r.target_punch_type, r.target_schedule_segment_snapshot_id, r.target_punch_slot_key, r.original_punch_event_id, e.server_punch_time original_punch_time, e.punch_type original_punch_type, r.requested_punch_time, r.reason, r.attachment_refs, r.status, r.business_round, r.approval_instance_id, r.row_version, r.last_approval_event_key, r.submitted_at, r.approved_at, r.rejected_at, r.cancelled_at, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from oa_attendance_correction_request r left join oa_attendance_punch_event e on e.punch_event_id = r.original_punch_event_id
mapper.insert: insert into oa_attendance_correction_request ( correction_request_no, client_request_id, client_request_fingerprint, user_id, user_name, shop_id, schedule_id, business_date, correction_type, target_punch_type, target_schedule_segment_snapshot_id, target_punch_slot_key, original_punch_event_id, requested_punch_time, reason, attachment_refs, status, business_round, approval_instance_id, row_version, last_approval_event_key, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{correctionRequestNo}, #{clientRequestId}, #{clientRequestFingerprint}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{shopId}, #{scheduleId}, #{businessDate}, #{correctionType}, #{targetPunchType}, #{targetScheduleSegmentSnapshotId}, #{targetPunchSlotKey}, #{originalPunchEventId}, #{requestedPunchTime}, #{reason}, null, 'DRAFT', 0, null, 0, null, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update oa_attendance_correction_request set schedule_id = #{scheduleId}, business_date = #{businessDate}, correction_type = #{correctionType}, target_punch_type = #{targetPunchType}, target_schedule_segment_snapshot_id = #{targetScheduleSegmentSnapshotId}, target_punch_slot_key = #{targetPunchSlotKey}, original_punch_event_id = #{originalPunchEventId}, requested_punch_time = #{requestedPunchTime}, reason = #{reason}, attachment_refs = null, row_version = row_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where correction_request_id = #{correctionRequestId} and user_id = #{userId} and shop_id = #{shopId} and status in ('DRAFT', 'RETURNED') and row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: where r.correction_request_id = #{correctionRequestId}
where r.correction_request_id = #{correctionRequestId} for update
mapper.update: update oa_attendance_correction_request set status = 'SUBMITTING', business_round = #{businessRound}, approval_instance_id = null, last_approval_event_key = null, submitted_at = now(), row_version = row_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where correction_request_id = #{correctionRequestId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}

update oa_attendance_day_result d join oa_attendance_correction_request c on c.correction_request_id = #{correctionRequestId} and c.schedule_id = d.schedule_id set d.settled_at = null, d.result_status = 'PENDING', d.exception_codes = 'CORRECTION_REQUEST_REVIEW_REQUIRED', d.row_version = d.row_version + 1, d.calculated_at = now(), d.update_by = #{updateBy}, d.update_time = now()

mapper.insert: insert ignore into oa_attendance_correction_approval_start_outbox ( correction_request_id, business_round, idempotency_key, request_json, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at, request_row_version, row_version, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{correctionRequestId}, #{businessRound}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestJson}, #{status}, 0, null, #{requestRowVersion}, 0, #{createBy}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select from oa_attendance_correction_approval_start_outbox where outbox_id = #{outboxId} for update

select from oa_attendance_correction_approval_start_outbox where (status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{dueAt})) or status = 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' or (status = 'PROCESSING' and claimed_at <= #{staleClaimedBefore}) order by case status when 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED' then 0 when 'PROCESSING' then 1 when 'RETRY' then 2 else 3 end, coalesce(next_retry_at, create_time), outbox_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update oa_attendance_correction_approval_start_outbox set status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_retry_at = null, claim_token = #{claimToken}, claimed_at = now(), row_version = row_version + 1, update_time = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}

update oa_attendance_correction_approval_start_outbox set status = 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED', remote_instance_id = #{remoteInstanceId}, remote_status = #{remoteStatus}, remote_business_round = #{remoteBusinessRound}, remote_succeeded_at = now(), last_http_status = #{lastHttpStatus}, last_error_code = null, last_error = null, claim_token = null, claimed_at = null, row_version = row_version + 1, update_time = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}

update oa_attendance_correction_approval_start_outbox set status = 'RETRY', next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_http_status = #{lastHttpStatus}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, last_error = #{lastError}, claim_token = null, claimed_at = null, row_version = row_version + 1, update_time = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}

update oa_attendance_correction_approval_start_outbox set status = 'FAILED', next_retry_at = null, last_http_status = #{lastHttpStatus}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, last_error = #{lastError}, claim_token = null, claimed_at = null, row_version = row_version + 1, update_time = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}

update oa_attendance_correction_approval_start_outbox set status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = now(), next_retry_at = null, last_error_code = null, last_error = null, claim_token = null, claimed_at = null, row_version = row_version + 1, update_time = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}
